name: CPU Cooling Policy (Active)
description: Sets the processor cooling policy to Active, prioritizing fan speed over CPU throttling for better thermal management.

description_i18n.en: Sets the processor cooling policy to Active, prioritizing fan speed over CPU throttling for better thermal management.
description_i18n.de: Setzt die Prozessorkühlungsrichtlinie auf Aktiv und priorisiert Lüftergeschwindigkeit vor der Throttling des CPUs für eine bessere Wärmemanagement.
description_i18n.fr: Définit la politique de refroidissement du processeur sur Actif, en privilégiant la vitesse du ventilateur par rapport au throttling CPU pour une meilleure gestion thermique.

warnings.title: Power behavior change
warnings.message: Power behavior may change, which can affect battery life, heat, or fan noise

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the processor cooling policy via powercfg to set both AC and DC values to Active (1), ensuring fans ramp up before frequency reduction occurs
